scope: Four frozen files; host coordination, GPUI Kit bindings and real browser were validated by root separately

corrections.review: The host has an outside-click cancellation handler. The missing scrim/centering is valid, but absence of outside cancellation was inferred from incomplete inputs.
GPUI Kit Enter.secondary is bound to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, and the form captures it for multiline fields. The claimed absent chord is false.
Each newly mounted note/diagram input starts empty, so selecting 0..0 does not create a visible selection difference.
The coordinator creates a fresh entity on each opening; the claimed stale text on reopening is false.
Original Mermaid parse errors appear in preview. Confirmation only requires nonempty text; invalid syntax is not a confirmation gate.
CSS z-index is not a direct GPUI API contract. Compare actual overlay occlusion and stacking rather than adopting its numeric token.

remaining: Original note/modal styling, Mermaid live preview and image inline bar are still implementation work; this review does not establish their parity.
